question: The “Sattriya” classical dance is associated with which state?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Assam__.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sattriya** is a dance form that is more than** 500 years old** and comes from the **Vaishnavite monasteries** of **Assam** northeast India.
 
• It was recognised as a classical dance by** Sangeet Natak Akademi **in **2000**.
 
• The Sattriya dance form was introduced in the **15th century** A.D by the great** Vaishnava saint** and reformer of Assam, **Mahapurusha Sankaradeva** as a powerful medium for propagation of the Vaishnava faith. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Some Other classical dance forms of India:**

 
 
• **​**__Bharatanatyam - Tamil Nadu.
 
• Manipuri Dance - Manipur.
 
• Kathak - Uttar Pradesh
 
• Odissi Dance - Orissa. 
 
• Kathakali - Kerala
 
• Mohiniattam - Kerala
 
• Kuchipudi - Andhra Pradesh
 
• Sattriya Dance - Assam
